author: Kuhn & Rueß GmbH
name: LDAP Server
description: Import Hosts and Objects from an LDAP Directory, inventorize their Attributes and look up Group Mail Addresses

account_custom_field_help.base_dn: Where the import starts searching, e.g. ou=servers,dc=example,dc=com
account_custom_field_help.search_filter: LDAP filter picking the objects to import, e.g. (objectClass=computer)
account_custom_field_help.attributes: Comma separated attributes to read, empty for all of them
account_custom_field_help.hostname_field: Attribute whose value becomes the hostname in the Syncer
account_custom_field_help.encoding: Character encoding the server answers in, e.g. utf-8
account_custom_field_help.allow_unencrypted: yes continues on a plain ldap:// connection when StartTLS fails
account_custom_field_help.rewrite_hostname: Jinja template rewriting the hostname, e.g. {{host}}.example.com
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_key: Prefix the inventorized attributes are stored under
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_match_by_domain: yes matches the object to a host including its domain
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_match_attribute: Attribute matched against the hostname of the Syncer
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_collect_by_key: Attribute whose objects are collected into one list
account_custom_field_help.inventorize_rewrite_collect_by_key: Jinja template rewriting each collected entry
